violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. PIC placed can opener into ware washing area to be washed, rinsed and sanitized. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

(corn beef, hot dogs, and eggplant rollatini), which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC voluntarily disposed of food at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. (Pasta) just prepped was observed placed in walk-in cooler at 182 degrees. PIC placed pasta in ice bath, re-temped then put pasta in shallow pans to continue cooling process. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

ROP frozen seafood products observed completely thawed with package intact. Frozen ROP seafood products that bear a label “keep frozen” must be completely removed from reduced oxygen packaging once taken out of the freezer to thaw or is stored in refrigeration holding an ambient temperature of 37 degrees Fahrenheit or below. PIC voluntarily disposed of ROP salmon at time of inspection. ROP guidance document provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The floor in the (bar) area has broken glass underneath shelf. PIC cleaned glass at time of inspection. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026
